summary: Revelation Biosciences filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026, reporting only that it released an updated corporate presentation, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and available on the company's website. The filing contains no special-situation event — no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, restructuring, delisting, or other corporate action. The 8-K is furnished, not filed, indicating it is for informational purposes only. This is a routine current report with no actionable transaction terms, deal mechanics, or regulatory triggers. The event is merely a company update to investors with no special situation classification warranted.
